figureLight.note: Errata 238, as errata 207 B graded four figures into their night: Prosperity is night, and act3-estate-sale's hen was painted in daylight browns and its raccoon halfway out in neutral greys, a little lighter than the sitting raccoon, whose sheet is painted into the night (reference/act3-estate-sale/handback.md). The moon's colour as a multiply, then the hen a little darker and greyer, so she reads as a brown hen at night rather than in daylight, and the raccoon in the sitting sheet's cool grey. Graded by sheet for him (FigureLight.sheets): his sitting sheet is not touched. Judged by eye at the hole beside the sitting raccoon. tools/check-figure-light.mjs measures both against Thad.
